worldcombat.skill.mirrormove.summary: Raise a mirror in front and throw the move the target just used straight back at it; it fails when the target has no mirrorable move yet.
worldcombat.skill.mirrormove.use.0: Throw a foe's last move back at it
worldcombat.skill.mirrormove.use.1: Break an enemy that just finished a swing
worldcombat.skill.mirrormove.use.2: Retake the beat a moment before a hit
worldcombat.skill.mirrormove.description: The mirror reaches up to %1$s blocks; only moves used within %2$s can be mirrored.
Windup %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.mirrormove.keen.on: Keen mirror: mirrored power ×1.2 and a longer memory, but windup +3 ticks and cooldown ×1.3.
worldcombat.skill.mirrormove.keen.off: Plain mirror: quick and cheap, but the reflection is not boosted.
worldcombat.skill.mirrormove.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
On: mirrored power ×1.2 and mirror memory ×1.25, but windup +3 ticks and cooldown ×1.3; off: a fast, plain riposte.
Only raise the mirror against a foe within this distance; smaller ripostes only up close, larger chases it down.
When on, the user may leave its post to mirror; when off, it only casts at what it can reach from where it stands.
